hindi: सन्धि और विग्रह के आसन और यान की व्याख्या की गई।
english: Of peace and war, staying quiet (āsana) and marching (yāna) are explained.
notes: sandhi rendered peace (glossary 8.5/12.5; 12.1 has treaty). vigraha = war. Refers back to the preceding chapters; the verb is singular (vyākhyātam) agreeing with the pair.

hindi: स्थान, आसन और उपेक्षण — ये आसन के पर्याय हैं।
english: Staying (sthāna), staying quiet (āsana) and neglect (upekṣaṇa): such are the synonyms of āsana.
notes: ca-iti is an unsandhied join of two words (ca, iti), so two entries. iti closes the list; rendered as in the glossary label formula (Such are ...).

words.gloss: in a part of the qualities
for the sake of obtaining one's own growth

hindi: किन्तु भेद यह है — गुण के एक भाग में स्थान है, अपनी वृद्धि की प्राप्ति के लिए आसन है, उपायों का प्रयोग न करना उपेक्षण है।
english: But the difference: [it is] staying (sthāna) in a part of the qualities, staying quiet (āsana) for the sake of obtaining one's own growth, and non-use of the means [is] neglect (upekṣaṇa).
notes: guṇa-ekadeśe: guṇa could be the six guṇas of policy or qualities in general; kept literal, medium. The ASCII/typed dash is the e-text's own punctuation. Hindi supplies only the bare copula.

words.gloss: of the enemy and the conqueror

hindi: छल लेने की इच्छा वाले और नष्ट करने में असमर्थ शत्रु और विजिगीषु का युद्ध करके आसन अथवा सन्धि करके।
english: For an enemy and a conqueror who desire to outwit [each other] and are unable to destroy [each other], [there is] staying quiet after making war, or after making peace.
notes: The sentence has no finite verb; the nominative āsanam is supplied with a bare "[there is]". The object of outwitting/destroying (each other) is not stated. vigṛhya-āsanam is a "-" join of two words. Dual genitive "of the two".

words.gloss: with the armies of ally and forest tribes
having done the external and internal tasks

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “अपनी सेनाओं से अथवा मित्र और वन-जातियों की सेनाओं से मैं बराबर वाले अथवा अधिक बलवान् को क्षीण करने में समर्थ हूँ” तब बाहरी और भीतरी कार्य पूरे कर चुकने पर युद्ध करके आसन में रहे।
english: Or when he sees, "With my own armies, or with the armies of the ally and the forest tribes, I am able to weaken [one] equal or stronger," then, having done the external and internal tasks, he should stay quiet after making war.
notes: daṇḍa = army (glossary). aṭavī = forest tribes (force sense). The object of karśayitum is left unstated ("[one]"). iti closes the quotation and is carried by the quote marks. utsahe may also be "I venture/dare".

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “उत्साह से युक्त, संगठित, खूब बढ़ी हुई मेरी प्रकृतियाँ बिना बाधा के अपने कर्म करेंगी अथवा दूसरे के कर्मों को नष्ट करेंगी” तब युद्ध करके आसन में रहे।
english: Or when he sees, "My constituent elements, endowed with energy, united and greatly grown, will carry out their own works unobstructed, or will destroy the works of the other," then he should stay quiet after making war.
notes: karma = works (what the constituents do); Kangle-style readings (their undertakings) possible. The two quoted participle strings are left asyndetic as printed.

words.gloss: harassed by own troops, thieves and forest tribes
from the route of the other's merchants
restraint of the treasonable, enemies and forest tribes
for the sake of warding off the other's growth

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “दूसरे से अपकृत, क्षीण, लोभी अथवा अपनी सेना, चोरों और वन-जातियों से व्यथित प्रकृतियाँ स्वयं अथवा उपजाप से मेरे पास आएँगी; मेरी वार्ता सम्पन्न है, दूसरे की विपन्न; उसकी प्रकृतियाँ अकाल से आहत होकर मेरे पास आएँगी; मेरी वार्ता विपन्न है, दूसरे की सम्पन्न, उसके पास मेरी प्रकृतियाँ नहीं जाएँगी; और युद्ध करके मैं उसके धान्य, पशु और धन को ले आऊँगा, अथवा अपने पण्य को हानि पहुँचाने वाले दूसरों के पण्य को लौटा दूँगा; अथवा दूसरे के वणिक्-मार्ग से बहुमूल्य वस्तुएँ युद्ध किए जाने पर मेरे पास आएँगी, दूसरे के पास नहीं; अथवा युद्ध में पड़ा हुआ दूष्यों, शत्रुओं और वन-जातियों का निग्रह नहीं करेगा, अथवा उन्हीं के साथ युद्ध पाएगा; मेरा मित्र, मित्र-भाव वाला, चढ़ाई करके बहुत-थोड़े समय में थोड़े क्षय और व्यय वाला धन प्राप्त करेगा, अथवा गुणवती, ग्रहण करने योग्य भूमि; अथवा सारे जमावड़े के साथ मेरा अनादर करके प्रस्थान की इच्छा वाला कैसे न चढ़ाई करे” — दूसरे की वृद्धि को रोकने के लिए और प्रताप के लिए युद्ध करके आसन में रहे।
english: Or when he sees: "Constituent elements wronged by the other, impoverished, greedy, or harassed by [his] own troops, thieves and forest tribes will come to me of themselves or by secret instigation (upajāpa); my economic activity (vārttā) [is] prosperous, the other's ruined; his constituent elements, struck by famine, will come to me; my vārttā [is] ruined, the other's prosperous, my constituent elements will not go to him; and having made war I shall carry off his grain, cattle and money, or I shall turn back the other's wares that damage my own wares; or, when war is made, [goods] of value from the other's merchant-route will come to me, not to the other; or the one made war upon will not [effect] restraint of the treasonable, enemies and forest tribes, or he will get war with those very [people]; my ally, of friendly disposition, having marched against [him], will obtain wealth with small loss and expenditure in much-little time, or land possessed of good qualities, acceptable; or, desirous of marching with [his] whole gathering, having disregarded me, how should he not march?" — for the sake of warding off the other's growth and for the sake of might (pratāpa), he should stay quiet after making war.

text_flags.why: possible typo: sāravanti ("having substance, valuable [goods]", sāra = valuables) fits the context; saravanti (flowing) gives no clear sense

notes: GROUPING: one long quotation over lines a-e, each non-final line ends with the e-text's "-" continuation mark. Doubtful points: (1) sva in sva-cakra is ambiguous (his own, i.e. the other's, troops). (2) bahu-alpa-kālam is literal "much-little time"; probably "much [gain] in little time" (bahu + alpa-kāla), alternative a dvandva "long or short time"; kept literal. (3) mitra-bhāvī taken as "of friendly disposition"; alternative "one about to become an ally". (4) vigṛhīta taken as the other king made war upon. (5) nivartayiṣyāmi caus. = "turn back"; the sense stop/keep out is the likely aim. (6) sarva-sandoha = "whole gathering" kept literal, i.e. marching with all forces and resources. (7) artha = wealth here (set against land), not the triad "gain". (8) pratāpa literally "heat", i.e. splendour/might. hiraṇya = money (glossary 5.2). The Hindi wording "युद्ध करके और" renders vigṛhya ca.

hindi: “क्योंकि लौटा हुआ उसी को निगल लेता है” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: "For one who has turned back swallows that very one," say the teachers.
notes: The referent of tam (that very one) and of pratyāvṛtta is not stated here; it continues the preceding argument about staying quiet after making war. Quotation closes with iti; formula as the glossary (X, say the teachers).

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: "No," says Kautilya.
notes: na-iti is an unsandhied join of two words; glossary formula.

hindi: इस व्यसन-रहित का क्षीण करने मात्र को करे, किन्तु दूसरे की वृद्धि से बढ़ा हुआ समुच्छेदन करे।
english: He should do mere weakening of this one who is not in calamity; but, grown through the other's growth, [he should do] uprooting.
notes: Ambiguous: (1) vṛddhaḥ may mean the opponent (grown through another's growth) or the acting king; (2) the verb of samucchedanam is understood from kuryāt (bracketed in English); (3) vyasanin = in calamity (vyasana of a constituent, glossary 8.1), avyasanin here read "not in calamity", alternative "free of vice". Kangle-type readings (weaken the enemy who is not in calamity, destroy him when he has grown by the other's growth) not applied.

hindi: इस प्रकार दूसरे का, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, बिना नष्ट हुआ इसे सहायता दे।
english: In this way the one to be marched against of the other, not destroyed, may give help to this one.
notes: Obscure: parasya yātavyaḥ taken as "the one of the other to be marched against" (the other's victim); alternatives: parasya depends on sāhāyyam, or "one to be marched against by the other". asmai = to the acting king (or the other), unclear. Optative rendered "may give".

words.gloss: one who has undertaken the whole gathering

hindi: इसलिए सर्व-समूह का आरम्भ किए हुए से युद्ध करके आसन में रहे।
english: Therefore, having made war with one who has undertaken the whole gathering, he should stay quiet.
notes: sarva-sandoha-prakṛta is obscure; taken as accusative object of vigṛhya (the one who has begun a full mobilisation, cf. unit 7 sarva-sandoha). prakṛta might also be "the topic/subject". The bracketed words in English are supplied.

words.gloss: in the contrariness of the causes of staying quiet after making war

hindi: युद्ध करके आसन के हेतुओं की प्रतिकूलता होने पर सन्धि करके आसन में रहे।
english: When the causes of staying quiet after making war are contrary, he should stay quiet after making peace.
notes: Compound with an absolutive as first member (vigṛhya-āsana, "staying quiet after making war"); prātilomya = contrariness, reversal. The "-" in sandhāya-āsīta joins two words.

words.gloss: by the causes of staying quiet after making war

hindi: युद्ध करके आसन के हेतुओं से ऊँचा उठा हुआ सर्व-समूह को छोड़कर युद्ध करके चढ़ाई करे।
english: Exalted by the causes of staying quiet after making war, he should march after making war, excluding the whole gathering.
notes: abhyuccita (abhi-ud-√ci) taken literally "exalted/raised up"; sense probably "strengthened". varjam used as an adverb "excluding"; sarva-sandoha as in units 7 and 12 (the whole gathering of forces).

words.gloss: on account of fire, water, disease, pestilence and famine
with depleted draught-animals, men, stores and arrangement of protection

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “दूसरा व्यसन में है, अथवा उसकी प्रकृतियों का व्यसन शेष प्रकृतियों से प्रतिकार के योग्य नहीं है; उसकी प्रकृतियाँ अपनी सेना से पीड़ित अथवा विरक्त, क्षीण की गई, उत्साह-रहित अथवा परस्पर से भिन्न हुई लुभाई जा सकती हैं; आग, जल, रोग, महामारी, अकाल के कारण दूसरे के जुते पशु, पुरुष, संचय और रक्षा की व्यवस्था क्षीण हो गई है” तब युद्ध करके चढ़ाई करे।
english: Or when he sees: "The other is in calamity, or the calamity of his constituent elements is not to be remedied by the remaining constituent elements; his constituent elements, oppressed by [his] own troops or disaffected, weakened, without energy, or split from one another, can be tempted; the other, on account of fire, water, disease, pestilence and famine, [has] depleted draught-animals, men, stores and arrangement of protection," then, having made war, he should march.

text_flags.why: stray extra e: śeeṣa should be śeṣa (remaining)

notes: vyasanī taken "in calamity" (calamity of the king himself; vyasana of a constituent element = calamity, glossary 8.1). Compound kṣīṇa-yugya-puruṣa-nicaya-rakṣā-vidhāna is ambiguous: kṣīṇa may qualify all members ("whose draught-animals, men, stores and arrangement of protection are depleted") or only some. yugya = draught-animal (literally "fit to be yoked"); maraka = pestilence (literally "killing"); nimitta here causal "on account of" (not glossary 13.2 "for the purpose of"). The pairs in the quotation are asyndetic as printed; the predicate "[has]" is supplied in English only.

words.gloss: having heroic, grown and devoted constituent elements

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “मेरे मित्र और आक्रन्द शूर, वृद्ध और अनुरक्त प्रकृतियों वाले हैं, दूसरा विपरीत प्रकृतियों वाला है, और पार्ष्णिग्राह और आसार, मैं मित्र के द्वारा आसार को अथवा आक्रन्द के द्वारा पार्ष्णिग्राह को, युद्ध करके चढ़ाई करने में समर्थ होऊँगा” तब युद्ध करके चढ़ाई करे।
english: Or when he sees: "My ally and the rear ally have heroic, grown and devoted constituent elements; the other [has] contrary constituent elements, and the heel-seizer, and the reinforcer; I shall be able, by the ally [to deal with] the reinforcer or by the rear ally [to deal with] the heel-seizer, to march after making war," then, having made war, he should march.
notes: ākranda, pārṣṇi-grāha, āsāra as glossary 6.2. The singular viparīta-prakṛtiḥ stands after paraḥ; the two ca suggest it also covers the heel-seizer and the reinforcer, so "[has]" is bracketed and the list left as printed. The construction mitreṇa āsāram ākrandena pārṣṇi-grāhaṃ vā (accusatives with instrumentals, no governing verb) is elliptical; "[to deal with]" is supplied in English only, not in Hindi. vṛddha taken literally "grown" (alternative: elderly, mature).

words.gloss: with the heel-seizer and the reinforcer

hindi: अथवा जब फल को एक के द्वारा ले जाने योग्य, थोड़े समय का देखे तब पार्ष्णिग्राह और आसार के साथ युद्ध करके चढ़ाई करे।
english: Or when he sees a fruit that can be taken by one, of short time, then, having made war with the heel-seizer and the reinforcer, he should march.
notes: phala = fruit (gain/result); alpa-kālam read as an adjective of phalam "of short time" (alternatively adverbial "in a short time"). hārya = "to be taken/carried off". Instrumental dual rendered "with".

hindi: विपरीत होने पर सन्धि करके चढ़ाई करे।
english: In the reverse case, having made peace, he should march.
notes: viparyaya = reversal, i.e. the opposite of the conditions of the preceding unit; sandhi = peace.

hindi: अथवा जब देखे — “एक के द्वारा चढ़ाई करना सम्भव नहीं है और अवश्य चढ़ाई करनी है” तब बराबर, हीन और अधिक बलवान् सामवायिकों के साथ मिलकर चढ़ाई करे, एक स्थान में निर्दिष्ट अंश से, अनेक स्थानों में अनिर्दिष्ट अंश से।
english: Or when he sees, "It is not possible to march by one, and [one] must necessarily march," then he should march, having united with equal, inferior and stronger associates (sāmavāyika), in one place with a specified share, in many places with an unspecified share.
notes: yātavyam is an impersonal gerundive ("march [one] must"), not the noun "one to be marched against" as in units 11 and 15; the subject is left unstated. sāmavāyika = those joined in association (allies in a joint enterprise), kept as a term. sama-hīna-jyāyas are relative strength (equal, inferior, stronger). ekatra / anekatra could also be "in one / in several cases".

hindi: उनके साथ न मिलने पर किसी एक से निश्चित अंश के साथ सेना माँगे।
english: In the non-association of these, he should request an army from any one of them with a fixed share.
notes: asamavāya = not coming together (the associates of the preceding unit do not unite); niviṣṭa (pp. ni-√viś) taken as "fixed, settled". daṇḍa = army (glossary).

words.gloss: with a share of the acquisition

hindi: अथवा मिलकर आगे बढ़ने से उपभोग करे, निश्चित लाभ में निर्दिष्ट अंश से, अनिश्चित में लाभ के अंश से।
english: Or he should enjoy [the acquisition] by advancing together, in a certain acquisition with a specified share, in an uncertain [one] with a share of the acquisition.
notes: nirviśyeta (nir-√viś) literally "enjoy", i.e. take one's share of the gain; the object is not stated. adhruve agrees with an omitted lābhe. abhigamana = approaching/advancing against; lābha = acquisition (glossary 13.5).

hindi: अंश सेना के बराबर पहला है, प्रयास के बराबर अन्तिम; अथवा लूट जैसा लाभ हुआ वैसी, अथवा प्रक्षेप के बराबर ही।
english: A share equal to the army [is] the first, equal to the effort the last; or plunder (vilopa) as acquired, or indeed equal to the putting-in (prakṣepa).
notes: uttama taken as "last" against pūrva "first"; alternative "highest/best" (glossary 4.11 uses highest for grades). daṇḍa = army. prakṣepa = putting-in (glossary 3.13), i.e. the contribution made; prayāsa = effort. vilopa literally plunder/carrying off; the verbless last clause is supplied only with a bare copula. Hindi verbless after अथवा.
